question: Can Runtime close the live-substrate block by (1) fixing distributed session replication (replace per-node SQLite with shared store or sticky sessions) to achieve C-FRESHNESS C1 TN>=0.85 on 2-node gunicorn 23.0.0 2x sync + nginx 1.24.0 round-robin with n_non304>=800 and stratified r within 0.15 (TOST), and (2) provisioning BrowserGym/AgentLab 0.4.2 (correcting 0.14.3 pin) + Playwright at 1280x720 with CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree capture (AX nodes>10, PC-HEALTH>=80%, DOM enumeration n=21-82) to resume C-MEAS-VALID discrimination beyond degenerate [1.0,1.0] — reporting per-value magnitude gradients (Cache-Control max-age/ETag/Content-Length sensitivity ordering) with non-degenerate bootstrap CIs to enable sensitivity ordering rather than binary 1.0 ceiling?
hypothesis: Two orthogonal substrate fixes close the 4-lane dependency cycle without paid CDN: (H1) Shared-store or sticky session replication restores C-FRESHNESS C1 behavioral TN to >=0.85 on 2-worker gunicorn 23.0.0 2x sync + nginx 1.24.0 round-robin under concurrency, with sufficient power n_non304>=800 and behavioral-structural orthogonality preserved (stratified pooled |r| TOST equivalence within delta=0.15, CI upper <0.15, TOST p_upper<0.05), whereas per-node isolated SQLite baseline remains at TN~0.667 (EXP-GRAPH-35611618323) replicating the distributed failure. (H2) BrowserGym/AgentLab 0.4.2 (correcting nonexistent 0.14.3) + Playwright 1280x720 provisions a live browser substrate where CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree yields AX nodes>10 per page, PC-HEALTH>=80% (pages with AX>10 / total), DOM enumeration n=21-82 nodes, and the identical HTTP fingerprint SHA256(status||body_bytes||sorted_filtered_headers) with EXCLUDED {Date,Server,X-Request-Id,CF-RAY,CF-Cache-Status,X-Cache,Age} retains discriminating body-only (B-BODY-ONLY 1.0, status 0.0, headers-no-CLEN 0.0) and header-only (full 1.0, headers-only 1.0, status/body 0.0, CLEN identity) isolation when fetched via Playwright browser context at 1280x720, with per-value magnitude gradients for Cache-Control (max-age 3601 1s delta vs 3600 vs 0), ETag (W/"fixed-aaa-112" 1char vs W/"fixed-aaa-111" vs W/"changed-bbb-222" full), and Content-Length/body size (32B 1B diff vs 33B 2B vs 35B 4B vs 70B 39B vs 117B 86B) reported with 95% bootstrap B=1000 CI [lo,hi], width and degenerate flag per magnitude to enable sensitivity ordering beyond the prior degenerate [1.0,1.0]/[0.0,0.0] ceiling (effective distinct N=1). If H1 and H2 hold with validity checks passing, the live-substrate block is closed for Graph DELTA-REPAIR/Intel Gate0/Physics replication without paid CDN.
falsifier: Falsified-in-setting (bounded to tested substrates) if with validity checks passing (shared-store file or Redis reachable and WAL COMMIT verified via SELECT before each batch, nginx round-robin confirmed via X-Worker-Pid distribution >=10 per worker, browser substrate provisioned with version 0.4.2 and CDP capture, fingerprint algorithm byte-identical to EXP-RUNTIME-35764329925 compute_fingerprint with sorted lowercased filtered headers, SEED 44, jitter 50-150ms, N per state 20 nominal): (F1) distributed C-FRESHNESS: shared-store or sticky arm TN mean <0.85 (or Wilson lower <0.75) on session-dependent endpoints, or n_non304<800 after 304 exclusion, or stratified pooled r equivalence fails (CI upper >=0.15 or TOST p_upper>=0.05) when per-node baseline correctly replicates TN~0.66 failure — indicating shared store/sticky does not fix replication; (F2) BrowserGym: provision fails (AgentLab 0.4.2 not importable or Playwright not installed at 1280x720), or AX nodes<=10 median, or PC-HEALTH<80%, or DOM nodes outside 21-82, or C-MEAS-VALID via browser fetch fails isolation (body-only AvsC full <=0.5 or status !=0.0 or headers-no-CLEN !=0.0, or header-only AvsE full <=0.5 or body/status !=0.0 or CLEN not 31==31) — indicating live browser observation layer not viable. Each branch falsifies independently (MIXED if one passes, one fails). Infrastructure failure yields MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification: GUNICORN_UNAVAILABLE, NGINX_UNAVAILABLE, SQLITE_SHARED_STORE_UNAVAILABLE (cannot create shared WAL file), REDIS_UNAVAILABLE (if shared store is Redis and not installed, fallback to shared SQLite), PLAYWRIGHT_UNAVAILABLE, BROWSERGYM_IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE, AGENTLAB_VERSION_MISMATCH (0.14.3 not on PyPI is expected, 0.4.2 must be available), CDP_AX_CAPTURE_FAILED, PORT_BIND_FAIL, COMMIT_NOT_VERIFIED, STATUS_MISMATCH, DECOMPRESSION_MISMATCH, SEED_NONDETERMINISTIC. Paid CDN unavailability is explicitly NOT gating (Director SUPERSEDE: pivot away from paid HIT/STALE/SWR/SIE/304; CDN credentials absent does NOT trigger MEASUREMENT_INVALID for this experiment). BrowserGym Image UNAVAILABLE still triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID for H2 branch but not for H1; H1 can still be decided independently and reported as MIXED.

baselines.description: Per-node isolated SQLite session store: each gunicorn worker uses isolated temp DB file (simulating per-node WAL not shared). Expected to replicate prior distributed failure: session_status TN=0.0 on round-robin, mean TN~0.667 across 3 endpoints (<0.85), n_non304 nominal but TN fails. Serves as strong negative baseline proving failure is replication not algorithm.

Shared-store fix: single SQLite WAL file at /tmp/spider-runtime-35784838353/shared.db (mode WAL, shared across workers) OR Redis shared store if available (fallback priority: shared SQLite file). Both workers connect to same store. Expected TN>=0.85, n_non304>=800, stratified r within 0.15. Primary intervention for H1.

Sticky-session fix (exploratory): per-node DB but nginx ip_hash (or hash $remote_addr) sticky routing ensures same client hits same worker. Expected TN>=0.85 as alternative to shared store, reported separately with distribution per worker skewed. Tests OR clause of Director mandate.

Fingerprint = hash(status) only. Expected 0.0 on 200 vs 200 body-only and header-only via direct and via Playwright browser fetch (proves status confound removed). Stable ID reused for AUDIT recomputation.

Fingerprint = hash(body_bytes SHA256) only. Expected 1.0 deterministically on body-only AvsC (31 vs 117 86B diff), AvsB (70 vs 31 39B), and gradient 1B/2B/4B diffs (32 vs31,33 vs31,35 vs31) via direct and via browser decompressed bodies, 0.0 on header-only AvsE (bodies identical 31B). Proves body signal when status constant.

Filtered headers including Content-Length. Expected via direct+BrowserGym: body-only 1.0 SOLELY via CLEN (31 vs32/33/35/70/117) with headers-no-CLEN 0.0, header-only 1.0 via CC/ETag/SC/Vary with bodies identical 31B. Isolates body-correlated vs independent header signal for gradient ordering.

Filtered headers minus Content-Length. Expected 0.0 on body-only AvsC/AvsB/gradients (no independent header drift), 1.0 on header-only AvsE and per-header isolations CC_small/large, ETag_small/large, SC_small/large, Vary_small when fetched via browser or direct. Critical isolation for sensitivity ordering (Cache-Control vs ETag vs Vary).

positive_control: Distributed C-FRESHNESS (P-FRESHNESS): Flask 3.1.3 PyJWT 2.14.0 HS256/RS256 + SQLite WAL shared store via 2x gunicorn 23.0.0 sync workers --workers 2 --bind 127.0.0.1:19860 + nginx 1.24.0 127.0.0.1:19851 proxy_pass http://gunicorn_upstream (proxy_http_version 1.1, proxy_set_header Connection "", proxy_buffering off) with round-robin (sticky variant ip_hash for B-STICKY). Endpoints: /api/profile, /api/data_list, /api/session/status with Cache-Control public max-age=5 / no-store and ETag-SHA256, If-None-Match ->304 at ~33% when cache_enabled, plus auth/session drift injection (valid vs expired vs invalid JWT, session_id present vs deleted). N nominal: 1200 paired behavioral+structural samples (480 per cache mode x2 plus 240 noise-only), after 304 exclusion target n_non304>=800 (stratified across 3 endpoints, validated via SELECT before each batch, batch_state_log.jsonl >=27 lines). Structural signal: hash(body)%10000 or Jaccard-equivalent per prior C-FRESHNESS harness (no shared variable with behavioral status_code/header/body hash per measurement_validity clause 7). Behavioral signal: graded session_status_check (401->1.0,403->0.5,500->0.75) plus auth delta composite. Must achieve C1 TN>=0.85 (mean across session_status/profile/data_list, each Wilson lower>0.75), C2 variance 8/8 conditions std>0.05, C3 orthogonality stratified r within 0.15 (CI upper <0.15 TOST p_upper<0.05), C4 FP<=0.15 on noise-only. Browser C-MEAS-VALID (P-BROWSER): same Flask app body_config/header_config via gunicorn+nginx origin as EXP-RUNTIME-35764329925: STATE_A 31B {"data":"hello","version":1} SHA d0ca833f, A1 32B 1B diff, A2 33B 2B diff, A3 35B 4B diff, STATE_B 70B 39B diff, STATE_C 117B 86B diff, STATE_E combined header (CC max-age=0,must-revalidate+ETag W/"changed-bbb-222"+Set-Cookie session=xyz+Vary Accept-Encoding,Origin) bodies 31B identical CLEN 31 identical, per-header isolations CC_small (max-age=3601 1s diff), CC_large (0), ETag_small (W/"fixed-aaa-112" 1char), ETag_large (changed), SC_small (session=abc value diff), SC_large (absent->present), Vary_small (Accept-Encoding vs Accept-Encoding,Origin). Direct fetch via requests (N=20 per state) and browser fetch via Playwright 1280x720 page.request/fetch inside BrowserGym/AgentLab context (N=20 per state, capture status, decompressed body_bytes, filtered headers via CDP Network.responseReceived + page.on response). CDP Health: Accessibility.getFullAXTree via CDP session per page (AX nodes>10), DOM enumeration via document.querySelectorAll('*').length (21-82 range). Expected: body-only via browser full 1.0>0.5 body-only 1.0 status 0.0 headers-no-CLEN 0.0, header-only via browser full 1.0 headers-only 1.0 status 0.0 body 0.0 CLEN 31==31, with per-magnitude Jaccard and bootstrap CI.
null_control: FRESHNESS null: noise-only structural drift (optional field churn, error_format_variation with bounded noise) with no auth drift, expected structural FP<=0.15 and behavioral FP 0.0, plus within-condition variance check std>0 for both signals. B-FLASK-ONLY baseline (flask_only_server without token validation) expected pooled |r|~0.02 trivial not gating. BROWSER null: same body STATE_A resampled N=20 vs N=20 via direct and via Playwright browser fetch (concurrent 4) with jitter 50-150ms, no write between, expected full 0.0 with 95% bootstrap CI B=1000 containing 0.0 and point <=0.05 and body/status/headers/headers-no-CLEN 0.0 each; same for header-A resampled, 403 same-state 0.0 via BYPASS, 401 same-state 0.0 via BYPASS. Degenerate CI disclosure required (effective distinct N per state, set size 1 vs >1, width 0 vs >0).
measurement_validity: Fingerprint algorithm identity: hash(status || body_bytes || sorted_filtered_headers_json) with EXCLUDED_HEADERS={Date,Server,X-Request-Id,CF-RAY,CF-Cache-Status,X-Cache,Age} plus disclosed X-Worker-Pid/CF-Connecting-IP, byte-identical to research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-35764329925/run_experiment.py:compute_fingerprint (sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), lowercased sorted keys). Code SHA logged; auditor recomputation 0 mismatches required. B-HEADERS-NO-CLEN same minus Content-Length. Bodies auto-decompressed before SHA (requests vs Playwright decompressed).

Distributed session validity: per-batch server state snapshot via SQLite SELECT on shared store (or Redis GET) logged in batch_state_log.jsonl (>=27 lines + warmup). POST /admin/set_body_variant and POST /admin/invalidate_session COMMIT verified (WAL COMMIT or Redis acknowledged) before 200; SELECT mismatch aborts batch as MEASUREMENT_INVALID COMMIT_NOT_VERIFIED. X-Worker-Pid distribution logged per observation to verify round-robin (>=10 per worker for B-PER-NODE/B-SHARED) vs skewed for B-STICKY (sticky check: same client IP hits same worker >90%). Shared vs per-node DB path logged in provenance.

Status/header/body identity after decompression: body SHA distinct across AvsC/AvsB/gradients (31B vs32/33/35/70/117) and CLEN==body_len verified via Content-Length header after decompression or Transfer-Encoding chunked reassembled body_len; non-CLEN filtered headers (Cache-Control,ETag,Vary,Set-Cookie) identical across body-only states, bodies 31B SHA identical and CLEN 31 identical across header-only isolations. Date/CF-RAY excluded and logged. Decompression mismatch triggers DECOMPRESSION_MISMATCH invalidity.

DOM enumeration via document.querySelectorAll('*').length logged per page (must be 21-82 per spec). BG health metrics PC-HEALTH = pages_with_AX>10 / total_pages. BrowserGym docker image am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping or ghcr.io/servicenow/BrowserGym inspected via docker image inspect if available else pure Playwright fallback still valid for H2 (docker not gating if Playwright succeeds).

Seed/jitter/ports/concurrency: SEED=44 deterministic for request order, jitter 50-150ms uniform between bursts (not between concurrent parallel requests inside ThreadPool 4), N=20 per state nominal for browser part and N=1200 paired samples nominal for distributed part, effective distinct N reported per source, fresh DB/file per run, nginx config at /tmp/spider-runtime-35784838353/nginx/, ports gunicorn 19860 nginx 19851 or next free, killed/purged on exit; Flask/PyJWT/SQLite/Werkzeug/gunicorn/nginx/AgentLab/Playwright/CDP versions recorded in provenance.json.

Artifact integrity and recomputation: raw_observations.jsonl (nominal ~520 lines browser+direct via gunicorn+nginx: 60 body-only +60 gradient +40 header +140 isolations +80 nulls +80 classic +60 sanity, plus distributed freshness raw_freshness_observations.jsonl ~1200 lines) with fields state,status,body_sha256,body_len,content_length_header,content_encoding,headers_filtered_json,headers_raw_json,headers_no_clen_json,fingerprint_*,worker_id,cdn_cache_status,ax_nodes,dom_nodes,viewport,timestamp,concurrency; batch_state_log.jsonl SHA logged; recomputation of Jaccard and Pearson r/TOST by auditor must match 0 mismatches; run_experiment.py SHA logged.

No shared-variable confound for orthogonality: structural signal must be derived solely from response body hash/Jaccard without including 401 error body constant (structural std>0 for valid and expired separately) and behavioral signal from status/header/session check only, with no overlapping hash composition, verified by recomputation (hash distribution per behavioral state). Violations trigger MEASUREMENT_INVALID per prior audit V1 residual request_id entropy.

Bootstrap CI non-degeneracy disclosure: 95% CI B=1000 resampling fingerprint sets per comparison for browser part; degenerate [1.0,1.0]/[0.0,0.0] reported as deterministic when set size 1 per state (effective distinct N=1), width>0 reported as non-degenerate if variance observed. Per-value gradient table must report width and degenerate flag enabling sensitivity ordering even when all remain 1.0 (then ordering is unknown but disclosed). For distributed part, Fisher z CI for Pearson r and TOST p values reported with n_non304 and endpoint stratification.
decision_rule: SUPPORTS (both substrates close block) requires ALL mandatory conditions with validity checks passing: (C1-FRESHNESS) shared-store (or sticky) arm mean TN>=0.85 across session_status/profile/data_list (each Wilson lower >0.75, session_status individually >=0.85) AND per-node baseline TN mean <0.85 (replicates 0.667 failure, proves fix is not tautological); (C2-FRESHNESS) n_non304>=800 after 304 exclusion (counted from raw_freshness_observations.jsonl, stratified across 3 endpoints, excluding 304 status); (C3-FRESHNESS) stratified pooled Pearson r equivalence TOST within delta=0.15 (95% Fisher z CI upper <0.15 AND TOST p_upper<0.05, CI lower >-0.15, pooled |r|<0.15) on shared-store arm, with 8/8 conditions variance std>0 for both signals and noise FP<=0.15 (C4); (C5-BROWSER-PROVISION) AgentLab importable version 0.4.2 (0.14.3 correctly absent), Playwright viewport 1280x720 verified, CDP AX nodes>10 median per page and PC-HEALTH>=80% and DOM enumeration n=21-82 on each page where measured; (C6-BROWSER-DISCRIMINATION) browser body-only AvsC full>0.5 expected 1.0 with status 0.0 headers-no-CLEN 0.0 and browser header-only AvsE full>0.5 headers-only 1.0 status 0.0 body 0.0 CLEN 31==31 via Playwright fetch (direct sanity also 1.0). Gradient reporting mandatory: G1_BODY (32B 1B,33B 2B,35B 4B,70B 39B,117B 86B) and G2_HEADER (CC_small 3601 1s, CC_large 0, ETag_small 1char, ETag_large changed, SC_small value, SC_large absent->present, Vary_small) each with full/body/headers/headers-no-CLEN Jaccard and CI [lo,hi] width degenerate flag per magnitude via both direct and browser — must be present in metrics with disclosure even if all 1.0 degenerate (ordering then unknown but not gating SUPPORTS). If any C1-C6 fails where validity passes => FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING bounded to failing branch (distributed vs browser). If shared-store and sticky both fail where per-node correctly fails => FALSIFIED for distributed replication. If browser provision fails but distributed passes => MIXED (distributed SUPPORTS, browser FALSIFIED/INVALID). If browser provision succeeds but discrimination isolation fails => browser branch FALSIFIED. Infrastructure-unavailable branches map to MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification: gunicorn/nginx unavailable, shared store file creation fails, Playwright not installable, CDP capture not available, AgentLab 0.4.2 not on PyPI (unexpected) => entire browser branch MEASUREMENT_INVALID while distributed branch can still be decided. Paid CDN absent is NOT invalidity per SUPERSEDE. Browser null FP>0.05 would falsify browser null stability (C6 subcondition).
product_consequence_positive: Both live-substrate blocks closed without paid CDN: (1) Distributed session replication fix (shared SQLite WAL file or Redis or ip_hash sticky) restores C-FRESHNESS C1 TN>=0.85 with n_non304>=800 and orthogonality preserved (stratified |r|<0.15 TOST), removing the per-node SQLite non-replication failure that blocked Graph C-DELTA-REPAIR and C-FRESHNESS distributed freshness (prior TN 0.667). Graph can now proceed to distributed delta-repair and freshness guards on 2-node gunicorn+nginx with trusted shared store. (2) BrowserGym/AgentLab 0.4.2 + Playwright 1280x720 with CDP AX>10, PC-HEALTH>=80%, DOM 21-82 provisions a live browser observation substrate where HTTP fingerprint discrimination remains non-degenerate in disclosure (per-value Cache-Control/ETag/Content-Length gradients with bootstrap CIs) beyond the degenerate [1.0,1.0] loopback ceiling. This unblocks Intel Gate0 harvest (BrowserGym provision + shared session store) and Physics live replication (AX DOM capture) and enables sensitivity ordering for freshness/delta-repair calibration. Claim ceiling expands from single-host gunicorn+nginx loopback EXPERIMENTAL to distributed shared-store + live browser EXPERIMENTAL; does NOT promote to VALIDATED or PRODUCT_CORE (still bounded to single-host 2-worker simulation, localhost, filtered header set, body magnitudes 31-117B, AgentLab 0.4.2, single browser viewport, no paid CDN, no multi-host Redis cluster). Next step is WebArena family hold-out or multi-host Redis if gradient shows non-degeneracy.
product_consequence_negative: Live-substrate block remains closed falsified: either (A) distributed shared-store/sticky fails to restore TN>=0.85 or n_non304<800 or orthogonality breaks (|r|>=0.15) on 2-node gunicorn+nginx round-robin even with validity passing — proving per-node SQLite WAL not fixable by trivial shared file/ip_hash and that distributed C-FRESHNESS requires true multi-host Redis or sticky cookie implementation beyond this substrate, blocking Graph distributed freshness/delta-repair until redesign; or (B) BrowserGym/AgentLab 0.4.2 provision fails (version not importable, Playwright 1280x720 not available, CDP AX<=10, PC-HEALTH<80%, DOM outside 21-82) or browser discrimination isolation fails (body/header 0.0 violation or CLEN mismatch) — proving localhost->browser generalization fails and loopback emulation does not predict browser observation layer, blocking Physics live DOM/AX replication and Intel Gate0 harvest. Either negative is high-information: bounds C-MEAS-VALID and C-FRESHNESS to single-host loopback EXPERIMENTAL only, prevents false VALIDATED promotion, forces substrate redesign (Redis shared session, header canonicalization, decompressed CLEN handling, BrowserGym image pull/Playwright install) before scaling. Negative still requires gradient reporting to diagnose most fragile header/body magnitude.
estimated_cost: Medium: single-host gunicorn 23.0.0 2x sync + nginx 1.24.0 (no paid CDN), shared SQLite WAL file creation at /tmp (no Redis cost unless available), Flask 3.1.3 PyJWT 2.14.0 already installed; gunicorn+nginx start ~2 min; distributed freshness harness N=1200 paired samples (profile/data_list/session_status with caching, If-None-Match 304) via nginx round-robin with 4-concurrency ~12-15 min including jitter 50-150ms; browser part: pip install agentlab==0.4.2 + playwright + npx playwright install chromium (~3-5 min if not cached, else <1 min), browser fetches ~240 observations via Playwright 1280x720 (body 60+gradient 60+header 180+nulls 80) ~8-10 min with CDP AX/DOM capture; total wall-clock ~25-35 min deterministic, no external paid services, no 2GB docker pull required unless BrowserGym image chosen (optional), cost dominated by Playwright install and observation loops.
expected_information_gain: Very high and discriminating: first test to jointly close the two systemic blockers identified by Global Research Director portfolio and Scout brief that have kept 4 lanes tunneling at synthetic ceilings (Runtime 44 C-MEAS-VALID at degenerate [1.0,1.0], BrowserGym 0.14.3 pin nonexistent, paid CDN HIT 0% with 273 responses, distributed TN 0.667). Pivots away from zero-VOI paid CDN (MEASUREMENT_INVALID 10/10 C1_CDN NOT_MEASURED) and localhost HIT iteration (960/960 byte-identical, CI degenerate) to the Director-binding live substrates with highest cross-lane VOI: shared session store unblocks Graph C-FRESHNESS/DELTA-REPAIR (4 BLOCKED) and BrowserGym AX provisions Intel/Physics. Positive closes localhost->distributed and localhost->browser promotion gaps with non-degenerate per-value Cache-Control/ETag/Content-Length sensitivity ordering for freshness policy calibration. Negative is equally decisive: proves shared file/sticky insufficient or browser layer not viable, falsifying the assumed easy fix and forcing true Redis/multi-host or alternative DOM observation before any distributed/product testing. Either outcome changes Codex claim ceilings from loopback EXPERIMENTAL to distributed/browser-evaluated (with non-degenerate CIs where edge variance exposed) and resolves the Director SUPERSEDE pivot, which no further loopback magnitude variant at 1.0 ceiling can address.
